RationalRate.description:
A frame rate as an exact rational. Never a float (invariant 12).

29.97 is 30000/1001 and cannot be represented in binary floating point.
Accumulating a rounded rate across an 8-hour soak drifts the clock, so this
type deliberately offers no `f64` constructor.

description:
Change the canvas: its rational frame rate and/or its size (11.43).
Frames are canonical (invariant 12): a rate change keeps every key
frame number and the duration in frames, so the graphic plays the
same frames at the new rate; only its wall-clock length changes.
